Send any contributions to: Sisters of Diana, Inc., RR1, Box 42A, Tishomingo, OK, 73460. Loan contracts also honored.
entries.notes: Continues from previous page, so continues_previous is yes, community_name inferred from contact name. Type is Land Fund/Seeking Land because they are 'raising money to expedite the negotiations and be on the land within 30 days'.

entries.description: Four lesbian separatists living on 17 secluded acres in northern California, looking for other lesbian separatists to join them and help build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments.
entries.raw_text: FOUR WOMEN living on 17 secluded acres in northern California are looking for other lesbian separatists to join them. There's a small cabin but women interested in joining them need to build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments. They are hoping that dykes will buy the land adjacent to them that is for sale for $17,000 ($3,400 down). Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit. Contact Joanie, 3100 Ridgewood Rd., Willits, CA, 95490 - Phone 707 459-5776.
entries.notes: Community name is opening words 'FOUR WOMEN'. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because four women live on the land and are looking for others to join them. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('lesbian separatists', 'dykes'). Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatists').

entries.contact_street_address: Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11
entries.description: A 160-acre space bought by a woman, located 25 miles southeast of Tucson, offering space for women and children to rent on a nightly or monthly basis.
entries.raw_text: NOURISHING SPACE FOR WOMEN is located on 160 acres 25 miles southeast of Tucson that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested. There is space for women and children to rent (there is an A-frame and plenty of land to camp on) on a nightly or monthly basis. They need a lot of financial support so for every $2 a woman donates, she is entitled to one free night of camping available any time in her life. In return for a donation they will send information and directions. Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11, Vail, AZ, 85641.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because 'a woman has bought' it and hosts women. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('any woman') and children ('women and children').

entries.description: Women squatted on a farm in Massachusetts, facing eviction, wanting space for women and no men.
entries.raw_text: ASHFIELD FARM WOMEN are "squatting" on a farm in Massachusetts. They have been told to leave but they are hanging on. They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them indefinitely for this action; also financial support. Sorry we don't have all the information about this, but write to the Ashfield Farm Women, Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because a group of women are squatting together on a farm. Accepted groups: Lesbian women implied by women-only space and context.

entries.description: A feminist country retreat run by a collective of five women offering workshops, discussion groups, and sharing country living.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE is a feminist country retreat. It is run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops to women seeking more about themselves and their lives. They say, "we feel that living with each other in the country has helped us to become stronger, healthier, more centered, and more creative. Some of the things we have been dealing with are our feminist politics, our sexuality and our own creativity. We know that we need contact with other women and also need to find a way to survive economically in the country. Womanshare is our way of doing this." Fees are on a sliding scale from $10 to $15 per day. Scholarships are available and child care is negotiable. Include partial payment ($10) when you register. The Womanshare Collective says, "we would like you to come and relax, join in discussion groups and workshops, enjoy good home-cooked food, and get to know us. We feel that being in the country, having a good time with other women can be a very high experience." For more information, write Womanshare, 1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526. Thanks to RUNES for this info.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is 'run by a collective of five women'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('to women', 'other women'). Focuses: Workshops/education ('workshops', 'discussion groups', 'Scholarships are available').

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York
entries.description: A retreat in the Berkshire mountains with a large A-frame house built solely by women, ten pasture acres for camping, and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT is a place in the country for women to get in touch with our many ways of doing things. It is a special place where women may come together away from the daily hassles of the patriarchal society and experience the strength of a woman's culture. It is not a resort. Each woman who comes to the land makes a commitment to herself and other women thereby accepting responsibility for herself, as well as by respecting and supporting other sisters who are there. Womens Ways is located in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York. There is a large A-frame house built solely by women. There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking. At present there are two permanent residents. As for accomodations, it is possible to rent the A-frame on a nightly ($3.50 - $5) or monthly ($70.00 plus utilities) basis. Camping is available for $2.50 a night or $40.00 a month and access to the house and utilities is available. Work exchanges are also available, as there is never a lack of projects around. Write or call for reservations or information: Women's Ways, Andrews/Mulholland, RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521.- Phone 518 385-6612.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is named 'WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT'. Acreage: 10 + 90 = 100 acres total (10 pasture + 90 wooded access). Residents: 2 permanent residents. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('women').

entries.description: A former mountain resort established as a women's collective retreat on 23 acres in the Adirondacks.
entries.raw_text: A WOMAN'S PLACE began in September, 1974 when seven women pooled their resources, purchased a former mountain resort, and established a women's collective dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women. Women are welcome to come for a day, a week, or a month, and A Woman's Place can also be reserved for groups of up to 30 women. A Woman's Place is situated on 23 acres in the Adirondacks; there is a main house where the collective women and their children live, four large nearby cabins and a recreation facility. The rates are on a sliding scale of $10 to $25 a day. Due to reservation demands, A Woman's Place needs a definite commitment on specific dates. Along with your reservations, please send a small deposit. Write to Mary Deyoe, A Woman's Place, Athol, NY, 12810 - Phone 518 623-9541.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is 'dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women ('all women'), and children ('their children').

entries.land_location_as_stated: on the Elwha River running through the back meadow
entries.description: An 18-foot tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals, and the Elwha River, owned by the gay community of Seattle with 3 gay men living in front houses and women in back forest land.
entries.raw_text: DEAREST WOMYN: For lesbians who are interested in country living, or passing thru and need a mellow atmosphere to stay in. We live in a 18' tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes. --KD & Barb Aehle - Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angeles, WA, 98362 - PH. 206 452-2435 * * * * * * * * * * *
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land because it is owned by the gay community of Seattle and hosted by two women (KD & Barb Aehle) under the two-woman rule. Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('lesbians'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('faggots').
